unknown_panel.title: Panel {product_id} is not in the brand table
unknown_panel.description:
Your panel at {address} works normally — its resolution comes from the device type, not from the brand, so nothing is missing in operation. Only the manufacturer field in the device registry stays empty.

Select **Learn more** to open a bug report that already has the technical values filled in. Please add the brand and the model, and a photo of the type label on the back if you can — that is the one thing only you can see. A photo of the packaging helps too, but is optional.

Once the product id is added, this notice disappears by itself.
